statement: let A := fun h : ℕ => ∏ p ∈ (2^h-1 : ℕ).primeFactors.filter (fun p => 2<p), (1 + 1/((p:ℝ)-2)); ∃ C : ℝ, 0<C ∧ ∀ L : ℕ, (∑ h ∈ Finset.Icc 1 L, A h) ≤ C*(L:ℝ)
